raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

AMD MI355X additions to the MiniMax-M3.1-Flash recipe (`recipes/models/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.yaml` only). No other open PR changes this recipe.

## Claims

1. **PD on MI355X**: `pd_cluster` renders the guide's 1P1D. One TP4 engine per role; BLHNC KV layout and NIXL with 4 threads; the prefill node drops `indexer_decode_cp` and offloads KV to host memory in 1 GiB HugeTLB pages (`SimpleCPUOffloadConnector`).
2. **TP4 on MI355X** for `single_node_tp` (Hopper keeps the FP8 variant's TP8).
3. **DBO / SP prefill** (opt-in feature, MI355X single node): SP + DBO, DBO, or SP. Guide section with the flags; one 32K-token prefill takes 1035 ms plain, 655 ms with DBO, 484 ms with SP + DBO (MXFP8 MoE).
4. **MXFP4 (Quark) variant**: `amd/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Quark-MXFP4`, MXFP4 W4A4 experts on the AITER MoE (`--moe-backend aiter`, no shared-expert fusion). `--quantization-config.moe mxfp8` moves into the default variant, since only that checkpoint stores NVFP4 experts.
5. **Mono decode** (opt-in feature, MI355X + Quark only): a decode step of up to 16 tokens runs each layer as one kernel. Needs FP8 KV and indexer caches and `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graphs. On the released image (aiter 0.1.26) it also needs #63270, the backport of #61889, to start.
6. **Fixes**: one `fp8` variant, limited to Hopper (the merge of `main` had duplicated the key; on MI355X and Blackwell it rendered NVFP4 caches). VRAM minimums per GPU: the NVFP4 variant shows 285 GB, and MI355X gets 533 GB after the MXFP8 re-quantization.

## Validation

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <vllm>/recipes` passes on vllm-project/recipes `main`. Rendered commands were checked for the default, Quark, and FP8 variants on MI355X, B300, and H200, with and without the new features.
- Rendered commands served on MI355X TP4 with `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:minimax-m31-flash`, DSpark 3, AIME26 (16 epochs, max_tokens 98304, thinking on) and MMMU-Pro (all, 3460):

  | command | AIME26 | MMMU-Pro |
  |---|---|---|
  | default (MXFP8 MoE) | 0.9351 x6 ¹ | 0.7676 x1 |
  | MXFP4 (Quark) | 0.9368 x6 | 0.7763 x1 |
  | MXFP4 (Quark) + mono decode, concurrency 4 | 0.9417 x8 | – |

  ¹ Same image, KV/indexer/MoE settings and DSpark 3, but served by our eval script (block verification), not the rendered command.

## Details

- The DBO / SP modes are offered on the default variant only (SP and SP + DBO were measured on the MXFP8 MoE); the Quark variant gets DBO.
- The recipe schema needs a mode per variant, so `mono_decode` carries an empty mode for the other variants: enabling it there changes nothing.
- The Quark MMMU run used `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{"video": 0}'`. With video inputs on, one Quark server ran out of memory in the vision encoder at MMMU concurrency 256 (`--gpu-memory-utilization` 0.92).

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to write the recipe changes and run the validation above; I reviewed the changes.

---

@@ -72,9 +72,97 @@ features:
     description: "Skip loading the vision encoder for text-only workloads — frees VRAM for KV cache."
     args:
       - "--language-model-only"
+  prefill_dbo_sp:
+    label: "DBO / SP prefill"
+    description: "AMD MI355X single node: faster long prefill steps. DBO (dual-batch overlap) splits a prefill step into two microbatches and runs one microbatch's all-reduce under the other's compute; decode steps are never split. SP (sequence-parallel prefill) keeps the residual stream sharded by tokens on steps of 4096+ tokens, so each layer's two all-reduces become an all-to-all and a reduce-scatter; it keeps a full o_proj copy per GPU (about 3.1 GB less KV cache)."
+    # Tested on the single-node TP4 engine only (not on a PD prefill node).
+    strategies: [single_node_tp]
+    default_mode: sp_dbo
+    # SP + DBO and SP were run on the default checkpoint only (MXFP8 MoE).
+    modes:
+      sp_dbo:
+        variants: [default]
+        label: "SP + DBO"
+        description: "SP prefill, and DBO on prefill steps of 16384+ tokens: each microbatch then has 8192+ tokens and stays on the SP path."
+        # DBO needs the V2 model runner: without it, --enable-dbo selects the
+        # V1 runner, which refuses the DSpark draft.
+        args:
+          - "--enable-dbo"
+          - "--dbo-prefill-token-threshold"
+          - "16384"
+          - "--dbo-decode-token-threshold"
+          - "32768"
+        env:
+          VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: "1"
+          VLLM_ROCM_MINIMAX_M3_SP_PREFILL: "1"
+        hardware:
+          hopper: unsupported
+          blackwell: unsupported
+      dbo:
+        label: "DBO"
+        description: "DBO on prefill steps of 8192+ tokens, no SP."
+        args:
+          - "--enable-dbo"
+          - "--dbo-prefill-token-threshold"
+          - "8192"
+          - "--dbo-decode-token-threshold"
+          - "32768"
+        env:
+          VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: "1"
+        hardware:
+          hopper: unsupported
+          blackwell: unsupported
+      sp:
+        variants: [default]
+        label: "SP"
+        description: "SP prefill on steps of 4096+ tokens, no DBO."
+        args: []
+        env:
+          VLLM_ROCM_MINIMAX_M3_SP_PREFILL: "1"
+        hardware:
+          hopper: unsupported
+          blackwell: unsupported
+  mono_decode:
+    label: "Mono decode"
+    description: "AMD MI355X single node, MXFP4 (Quark) checkpoint, low concurrency: a decode step of up to 16 tokens (4 requests with DSpark 3) runs each layer as one fused kernel; larger steps and steps with prefill run on the normal path. Uses FP8 KV and indexer K caches (fewer KV tokens than NVFP4) and FULL_DECODE_ONLY graphs, so prefill and mixed steps run eager."
+    strategies: [single_node_tp]
+    modes:
+      # The kernels read the experts as AITER MXFP4 tables, which only the
+      # Quark export loads as; they need the AITER sparse PA path, i.e. FP8 KV
+      # and FP8 indexer K caches in the shuffled KV layout, and no piecewise
+      # graphs.
+      mono:
+        variants: [mxfp4]
+        args:
+          - "--kv-cache-dtype"
+          - "fp8"
+          - "--attention-config"
+          - '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "fp8"}'
+          - "--compilation-config"
+          - '{"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}'
+          - "--gpu-memory-utilization"
+          - "0.85"
+        env:
+          VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT: "1"
+          VLLM_ROCM_MINIMAX_M3_MONO: "1"
+        # Measured on MI355X only.
+        hardware:
+          hopper: unsupported
+          blackwell: unsupported
+          mi300x: unsupported
+          mi325x: unsupported
+          mi350x: unsupported
+      # No mono path for the other checkpoints: an empty mode, so enabling the
+      # feature there changes nothing (the recipe schema wants a mode per
+      # variant).
+      none:
+        variants: [default, fp8]
+        args: []
 
 opt_in_features:
   - text_only
+  - prefill_dbo_sp
+  - mono_decode

-    # MXFP8 estimate above is used as an upper bound.

     precision: fp8
+    supported_hardware:
+      - "arch:sm90"
     vram_minimum_gb: 533
     tp: 8

+strategy_overrides:
+  # MI355X serves TP4 on half of an 8-GPU node; Hopper keeps the fp8 variant's TP8.
+  single_node_tp:
+    tp:
+      mi355x: 4
+  # MI355X 1P1D as in the guide's AMD PD section: one TP4 engine per role, on
+  # GPUs 0-3 of its node. Exact-GPU role blocks layer after the `amd` baseline
+  # and win the last-wins dedupe: the prefill node drops indexer_decode_cp (it
+  # never decodes) and offloads KV to host memory in 1 GiB HugeTLB pages; both

+  # of one per layer.
+  pd_cluster:

+          extra_env:
+            CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: "0,1,2,3"
+            VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT: "BLHNC"

+            - "--tensor-parallel-size"

+            # strategy's FULL_DECODE_ONLY.
+            - "--compilation-config"
